verdict.rationale: cubic is an AI code-review platform that also connects to coding agents through its MCP server and CLI, so a buyer could reasonably ask whether it supports live-app debugging. However, the evidence only covers reviewing PRs and local diffs, codebase scans, and passing review findings to agents. Nothing documents attaching to, inspecting, or debugging a live running web application from a coding assistant.

support.subject: As a developer, I can debug a live running web application directly from my coding assistant
